description_en: Renews one or more monthly subscription cloud computers
description_zh: 续费一台或者多台按月购买云电脑
kebab_example: aliyun ecd renew-desktops --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --desktop-id ecd-ia2zw38bi6cm70000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RenewDesktops

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The renewal duration. Valid values of this parameter are determined by the value of the `PeriodUnit` parameter.

If `PeriodUnit` is set to `Month`, valid values are 1, 2, 3, and 6.

If `PeriodUnit` is set to `Year`, valid values are 1 to 5.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
续费时长。取值范围由参数`PeriodUnit`的值决定。

`PeriodUnit`为`Month`时，取值范围为：1、2、3、6。

`PeriodUnit`为`Year`时，取值范围为：1~5。

默认值：1
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The unit of the renewal duration, which is the unit of the `Period` parameter
parameters.help_zh: 续费时长的单位，即参数`Period`的单位
parameters.name: period_unit

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable automatic payment
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en: The list of cloud computer IDs. Only monthly subscription cloud computers can be renewed
parameters.help_zh: 云电脑ID列表。仅支持续费按月购买云电脑
parameters.name: desktop_id

parameters.help_en: This parameter is not publicly available
parameters.help_zh: 此字段暂不对外开放使用
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The user ID for resource ownership in the reselling pattern. You do not need to specify this parameter if you are not using the reselling pattern
parameters.help_zh: 转售模式的资源归属用户ID，非转售模式无需填写该参数
parameters.name: reseller_owner_uid
